title: Pre-declared TM3 capability-absence determinations for the nine comparison languages
rule: Decision rule D0 fires only for a (language, case or program) entry listed here with branch TM3a. TM3b entries name the ordinary alternative construct that reaches the same hazard; the case then proceeds and is classified normally. A language and case not listed here has no capability-absence determination and is classified from its captured build and run output alone. Quidra's determinations are not in this file: they are made in the evaluated snapshot's quidra_type_binding_amendment.json, which the frozen case set requires before any Quidra program is written, and a Quidra row without a frozen determination is never TM3a.

citation.clause: 4.2 Primitive Types and Values - the integral types are byte, short, int, long and char; there is no unsigned integer type

ADV-04a.justification: With no unsigned 32-bit type there is no unsigned value to subtract below zero; the hazard cannot arise. Pre-declared in adversarial_cases.json case ADV-04 notes.

ADV-04b.justification: With no unsigned type there is no mixed signed/unsigned comparison to get wrong; the hazard cannot arise. Pre-declared in adversarial_cases.json case ADV-04 notes.

ADV-12.construct_absent: a declaration form that leaves storage without a value

citation.clause: Variable declarations; The zero value - 'When storage is allocated for a variable ... and no explicit initialization is provided, the variable or value is given a default value'

ADV-12.justification: Every Go variable declared without an initializer holds its type's zero value, so no storage location whose contents were never established exists; the uninitialized-read hazard cannot arise. adversarial_cases.json names this outcome explicitly ('Go has no uninitialized local').

ADV-01.alternative: bigint for the 64-bit value; an Int32Array element of length 1 for the 32-bit target

citation.clause: 6.1.6.2 The BigInt Type; 23.2 TypedArray Objects (Int32Array element conversion ToInt32)

ADV-01.justification: Pre-declared in adversarial_cases.json type_binding_table (fixed_width_i64 and fixed_width_i32 for TypeScript). The alternative reaches the same narrowing hazard.

ADV-04a.alternative: an element of a Uint32Array of length 1
ADV-04a.justification: Pre-declared in adversarial_cases.json type_binding_table (fixed_width_u32 for TypeScript).

ADV-04b.alternative: an element of a Uint32Array of length 1

citation.clause: 7.2 Assignment statements - names are rebound by assignment; the language defines no immutable local binding form

ADV-16.justification: Pre-declared in adversarial_cases.json authoring_choice_table (strongest_immutable_binding_form, Python): the hazard still arises, the closest form (an UPPER_CASE naming convention) is used, and the program is classified normally. This is explicitly NOT TM3a.
